description: Boot workflow runs daily (auto-triggered at 6am) but eval harness is not auto-capturing runs. Aug 22 eval exists because it was manually triggered. Today's boot (Aug 24, 06:05 AM complete) has zero harness wrapping. Root cause: boot workflow frontmatter lacks eval harness configuration. Jarvis claimed 'all future runs would be auto-captured' but no scheduled eval task or harness wrapper was ever built.
what_happened: Boot completed successfully but eval record was not created
what_should_have_happened: Boot completion should trigger eval harness wrapper that auto-creates an eval record with per-step metrics, guardrail outcomes, and completion status
proposed_fix: Route to Rigby to configure WorkflowStart hook in .claude/settings.json. Hook should fire when any workflow (boot specifically) starts and create eval record at that moment, capturing workflow name, agent, model, start timestamp. Boot workflow is daily automated — eval record must be created at START, not after completion.
solution: Configured PostToolUse hook with `if: Write(workflows/*/state.yaml)` matcher to fire when workflow state.yaml is written. Hook script (workflow-start.py) checks status=in-progress and creates eval record at workflow start. Uses existing hook system without infrastructure changes.
